title: Van podnosi K20
description: Niski krótki detal przy podłodze. Dłoń Vana gwałtownie podnosi świecącą K20, która leży przy jego bucie. Wyłącznie jedna czynność, bez portalu i zmiany lokacji.

prompts.image: Exact edit of revision 1: preserve the shot and reduce only the K20 to canonical 3.0 cm vertex-to-vertex, about 2.5 cm face-to-face, roughly two fingertips wide beside Vans hand and boot. Keep exact position, geometry, material, numerals and portal lighting.
prompts.animation: One continuous 1.5-second insert. Vans hand closes around the small canonical 3 cm K20 between his fingertips and lifts it cleanly off the tile as he begins to rise. Green reflections move across fingers and boot. Preserve exact hand anatomy, wardrobe, die scale, geometry and numerals. No duplicate die, extra people, morphing, cuts, captions, logos or watermark.
